name: Grade 8 IIIT Practice: September Week 2 - Events and Flow
description: Practice words for Grade 8 third-trimester app, Python, and Micro:bit work.

words.definition: To press with a mouse or trackpad.
words.example: A click on the start button opened the first game screen.
A tap on the mobile screen selected the answer.
The start event reset the score to zero.

words.definition: To turn in or send work.
words.example: Submit sent the finished prototype link to the teacher.

words.definition: Moving from one app screen to another.
words.example: The screen change moved from the menu to the game.

words.definition: A tool or variable that tracks time.
words.example: The timer counted down during the challenge round.

words.definition: An app or game value that changes when the user succeeds.
words.example: The score increased when the player chose the correct answer.
The bug made the score increase twice for one click.
